notes.text: The parallel appears in a succession of closing formulas after end of Mishnah and end of instruction. The Chida tentatively reads the last of the men of deeds and places Yonatan near the Savoraim; retain the technical term and the uncertainty.
The parallel has Rav Gadda and Rav Simona, with the Chida interpreting the rubric as the close of the Savoraim. Keep Simana and the separate received titles in Heilprin.
The exact parallel and the Chida’s attribution to Sefer Keritot are established. Direct print collation of the expressly cited gate remains open, so leave this locator unlinked.
